messages:
maria: Heads-up — I spotted a perf regression on a customer VPC last night after the kernel-selector tweak. p95 token latency doubled on a couple of routes.
aj: Which routes? pattern by seq len / model / batch?
maria: Primarily the long-context chat route (route_id=chat-long). Model is quantized Llama-variant. Batches were small (1-3) but many prefix tokens are cached. Perf snapshot from perfbot below.
perfbot: Profiling snapshot (172s sampling):
```
- p50 token latency: 5.8ms (baseline)
- p95 token latency: 8.2ms -> 14.6ms (regression)
- component median breakdown: decode 0.9ms, kv_lookup 0.4ms, kernel_exec 3.6ms, memcpy 0.6ms
- top diffs vs baseline: kernel_exec +6.1ms, memcpy +0.9ms
- kernel chosen: fused_attention_v2 (new selector) vs flash_attn (previous)
- kvcache hit_ratio: 94% -> 88% (slight drop)
```
sam: So it looks like the selector picked a kernel that increases device memcpy and kernel execution. Could be memory layout or extra tiled copies in the int8 path.
kevin: Do we have selector reasoning emitted? Why was fused_attention_v2 chosen (seq_len heuristic, host arch)?
maria: The selector now uses a lightweight cost-model that factors seq_len and token density. For these VPC workloads the average seq_len landed in the boundary where fused_attention_v2 was preferred. That kernel appears to do extra tiled copies for int8 tensors.
aj: We need richer token-level metrics labeled by kernel_name and kvcache status so customers can correlate latency spikes. Suggest: runtime.token.latency_seconds_bucket with labels {route_id, model_variant, kernel_name, batch_size, kvcache_hit}.
maria: We already export runtime.token.latency_seconds_bucket but it lacks kernel_name and kvcache_hit labels. Current labels: model, device, route. We'll add kernel and kv_hit.
kevin: Reminder for Private/VPC: cannot send customer PII off-network and air-gapped installs can't use remote_write. Options for richer metrics in-customer: (A) expose labeled metrics endpoint inside VPC for customers to scrape, (B) small Pushgateway locally, (C) file-based exporter writing .prom text snapshots, (D) ndjson dumps for one-time ingestion.
sam: Customers prefer not to run extra services. My vote: file-based exporter that atomically writes text-format snapshots to /var/lib/redwood/metrics/metrics.prom every 30s; they can use Prometheus file_sd to pick them up. Suits air-gapped setups.
aj: Agreed. That keeps everything local and avoids outbound. We'll provide example file_sd config.
kevin: Also add privacy guidance: strip request_id and user metadata before writing files. Include route_id (or an anonymized route hash), model_variant, kernel_name, batch_size, kvcache_hit_ratio only.
sam: For alerting/SLOs, propose:
- token_p95_ms{route_id=~".*"} threshold 12ms
- kernel_switch_rate (count of kernel changes per minute) > 5/min alert
- kvcache_hit_ratio per route rolling 5m < 90% alert
maria: I'll draft a Grafana dashboard with these panels: token latency heatmap by token index, token latency waterfall (decode | kv | kernel | memcpy), per-route kernel status + last_switch_ts, batch size distribution.
perfbot: New metric suggestions:
- redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route_id,model_variant,kernel_name,batch_size}
- redwood_runtime_token_span_seconds{component=(decode|kv_lookup|kernel_exec|memcpy),route_id}
- redwood_kernel_selector_reason{route_id,reason}
- redwood_kvcache_hit_ratio{route_id}
- redwood_kernel_switch_count_total{route_id,old_kernel,new_kernel}
aj: For file_sd example (prom config):
```
- job_name: 'redwood-file-export'
  file_sd_configs:
    - files:
      - '/var/lib/redwood/metrics/*.json'
  metrics_path: /metrics
```
Note: our exporter will generate files that either represent scrape targets or plain text metrics endpoints; we'll document both modes.
kevin: Telemetry must have levels: minimal (default) vs verbose (opt-in). Verbose enables kernel_name and token spans. Private installs default to minimal and can opt-in via config.
maria: Action items:
- (maria) add kernel_name and kv_hit labels to token latency; emit token component spans. ETA: 2d
- (aj) prototype file-based exporter + file_sd examples. ETA: 3d
- (sam) create Grafana draft dashboard + SLO panels. ETA: 4d
- (kevin) instrument kernel_selector_reason metric; add opt-in verbose telemetry flag. ETA: 5d
- (team) security write privacy guidance for VPC exporters. ETA: 2d
kevin: Short-term mitigation: make selector prefer flash_attn for quantized int8 models with seq_len > 1024 until we understand memcpy pattern. Can we hotpatch a per-tenant override in router config?
maria: Yes — I'll add a per-tenant kernel override toggle that can be flipped without deploy.
aj: I'll add a quick single-stat Grafana panel showing current kernel_name per route so customers can spot switches.
sam: Customer also requested a one-time anonymized dump of profiled token spans. We can provide ndjson they can ingest into Loki or perf tools.
maria: I'll open a tracking ticket and link PRs when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-3247: "VPC perf instrumentation + file exporter" assigned to maria,aj,sam,kevin
aj: I'll share exporter repo once live: https://git.internal/redwood/metrics-exporter (private)
maria: tagging @kevin to confirm hotfix toggle for that tenant.
kevin: Confirmed — I'll test and roll the toggle tomorrow morning.
